source.scope: Only three Runtime production files and their existing unit test file; qualified ledger-handoff source is the unchanged dependency baseline. No live, codec, schema, authority, config, consensus, dependency or lock changes.

controlled_negative.statement: Baseline production plus the new child-alias regression accepted different valid contents under the expected map key and cached commitment. The same unchanged regression passes with explicit requested/object hash binding.

semantics: Requested map key equals StoredObject.hash before logical or physical page resolution; actual SQL Reader already constructs those identities from the same row hash, so this is not claimed as a current SQL exploit.
Flat decoder, native full inode flatten/context checks and contents hash/empty-edge checks are byte-identical to baseline.

VerifiedDirectory fields and sole value constructor are private to restore.rs, after existing complete directory commitment and page-edge authentication. Snapshot Finish consumes the token and retains logical child existence/kind/duplicate checks.

Legacy flat directories perform their native node hash once rather than three times. Inode logical native-root recomputation remains, and contents commitment validation remains before cache population.
limits: No public observer restart, throughput, RSS or cold-start performance claim is included; parent must adopt exact files and measure retained public state.
Full state restoration and every physical page/content/edge authentication remain; logical directory scans and necessary hashing remain O(width).
Native proof verification and unchanged Rust producer roundtrips are distinct from a dedicated independent native-producer wire differential; no new broad proof-producer parity claim is made.
Independent gateway/Single candidates are outside this snapshot and require separate integration gates.
